name: Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends two faults of the original and changes nothing else: the walking bugs that turn off a vertical way wait between turns as they do off a horizontal one, and an enemy's shield flash starts in the right place. The walkers' fix starts off, since their quick turns can read as a designed pattern. Turn a fix off to play the original as it was.

settings.label: Walkers wait between turns
settings.help: A walking bug that comes to a side way turns onto it half the time, but not again for five seconds. The original forgot the wait for bugs going up or down; here they wait too.

settings.label: Shield flash starts in place
settings.help: When a beam touches an enemy its shield flashes. The original starts the flash at the enemy's x for its height, so it can show in the wrong place for an update. Here it starts on the enemy.
